summary.one_line: External source builds and existing-package deploy semantics are accurately documented in both languages.

purpose.evidence: Read both changed Markdown paths. README introduces separate mod checkouts, and docs/commands places --source in the existing resource workflow. The feature's purpose—build H5U from a checkout while keeping outputs in H5_WORKSPACE—is clear.

structure.evidence: The new section sits after the first marker cycle and before map/control guidance, with one code example and an EN counterpart. docs/commands adds a concise CLI note near build/deploy/cycle. Existing sandbox and rollback guidance remains in place.

specificity.evidence: Inspected Workshop.__init__, build and deploy: --source resolves an external folder, build reads its mod.json and requires recipe id == selected --mod, outputs/state still use H5_WORKSPACE, and embedded object_reference is preferred for a reference_windows recipe. The final external-source test uses a second TemporaryDirectory and asserts the source is outside H5_WORKSPACE. README/commands now say only build/cycle reads the external recipe; deploy installs the already built artifact and does not reread mod.json.

reproducibility.evidence: The final example builds from an external checkout and deploys the owned H5U without a redundant --source flag. It tells readers to rebuild after any recipe edit. Parent reports 39 Python/8 Node tests passing; the new external-source test exercises a directory outside the workspace. No fresh game run or full bank-mod equivalence is claimed by this devkit doc change.

evidence.evidence: Compared source and paired docs: self.source is selected from --source or legacy H5_WORKSPACE/mods/<id>; build() reads mod.json and validates selected ID; deploy() uses the saved artifact/build report and rechecks resource/template/binary hashes and target ownership. README/commands now state this accurately in both languages. I did not launch the game or inspect user files.

applicability.evidence: The feature is optional and preserves the legacy workspace recipe fallback. README scopes it to a separate checkout, says source directory name need not equal mod ID, and keeps outputs/state in H5_WORKSPACE. Existing --sandbox, installed-game and no-live-acceptance limits remain. The wording finding affects deploy semantics, not the documented existence of separate source builds.

translations.evidence: RU and EN README/commands additions now agree on --source for build/cycle, matching recipe id, embedded catalog, legacy fallback, explicit rebuild after edits and deploy's use of an existing package; both give the 39-test count. No material translation divergence remains.

maintenance.evidence: The CLI addition is paired with README/commands and two new behavior tests, with the external source test strengthened to run outside H5_WORKSPACE. No mod-specific recipe was copied into the shared devkit. The documented output ownership remains under H5_WORKSPACE, and review:info lists exactly README.md and docs/commands.md for this final diff.
